title: Projet GORDES — Édition numérique de la correspondance du baron de Gordes (1565–1576)
institution: Université Sorbonne Paris Nord (PLÉIADE) / Institut de France, Bibliothèque et Archives du château de Chantilly
notes:
Scholarly edition of the correspondence received by Bertrand-Raimbaud de Simiane, baron de Gordes, lieutenant-général du roi en Dauphiné: transcriptions with facsimiles, thematic indexing (proper names, places, text strings) and cartography. The site states 1,771 letters/documents consultable online out of 7,018 in series K of the Chantilly archives (partial coverage, vols. XVII–XIX / 1572 emphasized). Transcriptions are displayed as HTML; no machine-readable file download was verified in this run, so encoding is recorded as html and no data_url is given.

Justification: Freely accessible scholarly digital edition of a major 16th-century French correspondence corpus, squarely within 1450–1700 and not in the catalogue; found via a general web search for new French digital editions of 16th-century letters and verified on the project site.
Found at: https://www.projetgordes.fr/1/accueil
